subject.title: feat(ui): call chat sessions threads and quiet the sidebar sections

question: Should the Control UI standardize its chat-creation surfaces on “thread” and adopt this sidebar/titlebar action placement for the current product direction?
rationale: The change is a visible terminology and interaction-design decision, and the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the supplied tests and visual proof support the implementation.

options.title: Accept the unified thread direction
options.body: Merge after final exact-head review if maintainers want chat creation in this UI scope consistently named and presented as threads.

options.title: Request a narrower terminology scope
options.body: Keep existing session wording outside the explicitly chosen surfaces and ask for a smaller follow-up focused only on the sidebar layout.

recommendation.title: Accept the unified thread direction
recommendation.body: Merge after final exact-head review if maintainers want chat creation in this UI scope consistently named and presented as threads.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR context identifies steipete as the only directly connected contributor to the proposed UI direction; current-main ownership history was not available to establish a stronger routing candidate.
